title: Non-local service needs comparable safeguards and controlled reconnection evidence
remediation: The deployment system security owner and service custodian compare the non-local maintenance environment and tools with the assessed system safeguards. Verify a sampled component was removed and sanitized before service, inspected and sanitized for potentially malicious software afterward, and checked before reconnecting under approved custody and release rules.

milestones.title: Collect the reviewed safeguards comparison, removal and pre-service sanitization records, and post-service inspection, sanitization and reconnection approval
